verdict.rationale: LangSmith auto-creates prebuilt per-project dashboards that explicitly cover token usage. It also supports custom chart collections that can be grouped by run tag or metadata, and it tracks Cost as a first-class metric, which is shown by threshold alerting on it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cost charts in dashboards, explicit per-model and per-request cost/token breakdowns (only implied via metadata grouping and traces), time-range controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
